** '''Player:''' Have you got anything for me?

===Claiming Additional XP Lamps===

==Searching the cupboard north of the papyrus spawn after the Legends' Quest==
* '''Radimus Erkle:''' Hey, I think it's about time you started buying your own machetes. I'm sure there must be some jungle native down in Karamja who can sell you one.
* {{tact|end}}

==Treasure Trails==
===Master===
* '''Radimus Erkle:''' Here, solve this.
* {{tact|receives=a puzzle box}}
* {{tbox|Radimus Erkle hands you a puzzlebox!}}
* {{tact|end}}
====Talking again====
* {{tcond|If the puzzle box is not solved:}}
** '''Radimus Erkle:''' That doesn't look solved to me.
** {{tact|end}}
* {{tcond|If the puzzle box is solved:}}
** '''Radimus Erkle:''' Well done [player name]. Here you go.
** {{tact|receives=a [new clue/casket]}}
** {{tbox|You've obtained a [new clue/casket]!}}
** {{tact|end}}
